description:
Players whose dynasty market value has moved most recently — risers and fallers, with the size of the move.

USE WHEN: the user asks who is trending up or down, wants buy-low or sell-high candidates, or asks what changed in the market.
Movement is measured against a recent market baseline, not a fixed window, so treat it as 'what the market has repriced lately'.

direction.description: Risers, fallers, or both by absolute move (default 'both').

name: tradegauge_get_value_movers
title: Get recent value movers
